text:
```yaml
name: Release Studio

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  release:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version-file: 'go.mod'
          cache: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: go mod download

      - name: Run validation checks
        run: |
          make format
          make check-command-docs
          make lint
          ASC_BYPASS_KEYCHAIN=1 make test

      - name: Build binary
        run: |
          go build -o asc ./cmd/asc
          chmod +x asc

      - name: Create archive
        uses: thedoctor0/zip-release@0.7.6
        with:
          type: 'zip'
          filename: 'asc-${{ github.ref_name }}-darwin-amd64.zip'
          path: 'asc'

      - name: Create Release
        uses: svenstaro/upload-release-action@v2
        with:
          repo_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          file: asc-${{ github.ref_name }}-darwin-amd64.zip
          asset_name: asc-${{ github.ref_name }}-darwin-amd64.zip
          tag: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          overwrite: true
          release_name: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          body: |
            ## App Store Connect CLI ${{ github.ref_name }}

            ### Publishing Guidance Update
            - `asc release run` is now the single canonical App Store publish path.
            - `asc publish appstore` and `asc submit create` are deprecated but remain available for compatibility.

            See `docs/architecture/publishing-process-simplification.md` for detailed migration guidance.
```
